description: A reified 'observationBase' relation: an evidence node and the data it rests on (subject = evidence, object = a data record, tech.scios.rrgi.entity: a figure panel, a table or a data file). Maps to the MIRA schema's observationBase slot (github.com/MIRA-science/schema, mira.yaml on main: slot_uri mira:observationBase, title 'Observation base', 'The data on which the observation is based', domain Evidence, range Entity — prov:Entity). One of MIRA's four evidence links, added to RRGI on 2026-10-03 with the data record it points at. One data record can be the base of several evidence nodes, and credit for it is given once, on the data record (tech.scios.rrgi.attribution); views count an evidence node linked to an attributed data record as attributed by that record's makers. MIRA marks observationBase's range as provisional: mira.yaml's own comment on it reads "That range is very, very provisional. could also involve schema:DigitalDocument , schema:Dataset", so this shape may change when MIRA settles it. MIRA adds that the entity should be generated by the activity the source describes (a property chain it deliberately does not assert). RRGI's intentional divergence (matching supports): subject/object are dual-addressed via com.atproto.repo.strongRef (uri + cid) instead of a bare at-uri, so the edge pins exact content versions and cannot rot. NOTE: no upstream atproto lexicon exists for this type yet; authored ahead of upstream from the MIRA schema, intended to be proposed back.

subject.description: Dual-addressed reference (URI + CID) to the evidence (the observation). RRGI divergence from upstream's bare at-uri: com.atproto.repo.strongRef requires both uri and cid, so the CID is mandatory.

object.description: Dual-addressed reference (URI + CID) to the data record it is based on (tech.scios.rrgi.entity). See subject: RRGI divergence, CID mandatory.

description.description: Optional elaboration: which part of the data the observation rests on.
